policy.freeze_boundary: The submitted baseline is frozen before any diagnostic held-out score is computed.
policy.heldout_use: Held-out probe scores are forensic evidence only; they cannot replace the baseline or select later ticket settings.
policy.interpretation: Compare dev and held-out deltas for agreement; do not rank probes by held-out F1.
policy.matrix: fixed one-factor diagnostic matrix defined in pipeline.experiments
policy.representative_transition_probes: c_10 and no_vector_normalization are fixed after dev comparison and before held-out evaluation.
